project: Self-Evolving Explainable Rational Agent for Adaptive Industrial Decision Intelligence Using Statistical Trend Learning
actions_performed: Read existing JSON reports from known step output directories
Created a separate corrected copy of bootstrap interpretation labels

bootstrap_interpretation_audit.assumption: Each comparison is A_minus_B and the observed difference is RMSE(A) - RMSE(B). A negative interval favors A; a positive interval favors B; an interval containing zero is inconclusive.

extracted_findings: Step 8.5 fitted linear calibration using training-partition out-of-fold predictions only. Validation labels were evaluation-only; no test labels were used.
Step 8.7 final-cycle regression metrics were read from step08_7_final_cycle_regression_metrics_FD001.csv; they refer to 20 validation engines, not all 4,070 validation cycle rows.
limitations: This is a synthesis of existing outputs, not a full independent rerun.
Only 20 engines are available in the reported validation partition.
Illustrative maintenance costs are not measured industrial costs.
Calibration results may not generalize to other subsets or datasets.
The workflow does not prove continuous online self-evolution.
Test results must not be used to retune the system.
